description: Interface defining methods for reading and retrieving loan account data, transaction templates, schedules, and related information within the Fineract loan portfolio module.

classes.name: LoanReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface for reading loan account data and related information within the Fineract system.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieve a loan account data by loan ID.

methods.name: fetchRepaymentScheduleData
methods.description: Fetch repayment schedule data for a given loan account.

methods.name: retrieveRepaymentSchedule
methods.description: Retrieve the repayment schedule for a loan, including disbursements and repayment periods.

methods.name: retrieveLoanTransactions
methods.description: Retrieve all transactions for a specific loan.

methods.name: retrieveLoanTransactionTemplate
methods.description: Get a template for a loan transaction, optionally by transaction type and ID.

methods.name: retrieveWaiveInterestDetails
methods.description: Retrieve details for waiving interest on a loan.

methods.name: retrieveLoanTransaction
methods.description: Retrieve a specific loan transaction by loan and transaction ID.

methods.name: retrieveNewClosureDetails
methods.description: Get details for a new loan closure transaction.

methods.name: retrieveDisbursalTemplate
methods.description: Get a disbursal transaction template for a loan.

methods.name: retrieveApprovalTemplate
methods.description: Retrieve loan approval template data.

methods.name: retrieveTemplateWithClientAndProductDetails
methods.description: Get a loan account template with client and product details.

methods.name: retrieveTemplateWithGroupAndProductDetails
methods.description: Get a loan account template with group and product details.

methods.name: retrieveTemplateWithCompleteGroupAndProductDetails
methods.description: Get a comprehensive group and product loan template.

methods.name: retrieveLoanProductDetailsTemplate
methods.description: Retrieve loan product details template.

methods.name: retrieveCalendars
methods.description: Retrieve calendar data for a group.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieve all loan accounts matching search parameters.

methods.name: retrieveAllowedLoanOfficers
methods.description: Retrieve allowed loan officers for an office.

methods.name: retrieveAllLoansWithOverdueInstallments
methods.description: Retrieve all loans with overdue installments, considering penalty wait period and backdating.

methods.name: retrieveAllOverdueInstallmentsForLoan
methods.description: Retrieve overdue installments for a specific loan.

methods.name: retriveLoanCounter
methods.description: Get the count of loans for a group or client, filtered by loan type and product.

methods.name: retrieveLoanDisbursementDetails
methods.description: Retrieve disbursement details for a loan.

methods.name: retrieveLoanDisbursementDetail
methods.description: Retrieve specific disbursement detail for a loan.

methods.name: retrieveRecoveryPaymentTemplate
methods.description: Get a template for recovery payment.

methods.name: retrieveLoanWriteoffTemplate
methods.description: Get a template for loan write-off.

methods.name: retrieveLoanChargeOffTemplate
methods.description: Get a template for loan charge-off.

methods.name: fetchLoansForInterestRecalculation
methods.description: Retrieve loans pending interest recalculation.

methods.name: fetchLoansForInterestRecalculation
methods.description: Retrieve a paginated list of loans for interest recalculation.

methods.name: retrieveLoanPrePaymentTemplate
methods.description: Get a prepayment template for a loan.

methods.name: isGuaranteeRequired
methods.description: Check if a guarantee is required for a loan.

methods.name: retrieveMinimumDateOfRepaymentTransaction
methods.description: Retrieve the minimum date for repayment transactions.

methods.name: retrieveTotalPaidInAdvance
methods.description: Retrieve total amount paid in advance for a loan.

methods.name: retrieveRefundByCashTemplate
methods.description: Get a refund template by cash for a loan.

methods.name: retrieveCreditBalanceRefundTemplate
methods.description: Get a credit balance refund template.

methods.name: retrieveLoanInterestRatePeriodData
methods.description: Retrieve interest rate period data for a loan.

methods.name: retrieveLoanIdsWithPendingIncomePostingTransactions
methods.description: Retrieve loan IDs with pending income posting transactions.

methods.name: retrieveLoanForeclosureTemplate
methods.description: Get a foreclosure template for a loan.

methods.name: retrieveLoanByLoanAccount
methods.description: Retrieve loan account data by loan account number.

methods.name: retrieveLoanIdByAccountNumber
methods.description: Retrieve loan ID by account number.

methods.name: retrieveAccountNumberByAccountId
methods.description: Retrieve account number by account ID.

methods.name: retrieveNumberOfActiveLoans
methods.description: Get total number of active loans.

methods.name: retrieveNumberOfRepayments
methods.description: Get number of repayments for a loan.

methods.name: retrieveGLIMChildLoansByGLIMParentAccount
methods.description: Retrieve GLIM child loans by parent account number.

methods.name: getRepaymentDataResponse
methods.description: Get repayment schedule data response for a loan.

methods.name: retrieveLoanTransactionIdByExternalId
methods.description: Retrieve loan transaction ID using external ID.

methods.name: retrieveLoanIdByExternalId
methods.description: Retrieve loan ID using external ID.

methods.name: retrieveLoanIdsByExternalIds
methods.description: Retrieve list of loan IDs by external IDs.

methods.name: existsByLoanId
methods.description: Check if a loan exists by loan ID.

methods.name: retrieveManualInterestRefundTemplate
methods.description: Get manual interest refund template.

methods.name: getResolvedLoanId
methods.description: Resolve external loan ID to internal ID.

methods.name: getResolvedLoanTransactionId
methods.description: Resolve external transaction ID to internal ID.
